title: Red Panda in Desert Tree
description: A lone red panda curls asleep on the thick branch of a gnarled, leafless tree growing from a sand dune. The tree's branches support a large fishing net filled with colorful glowing orbs under a giant pink full moon in a starry twilight sky.
prompt: A majestic gnarled tree growing from the crest of a sand dune in a vast desert at sunset. A red panda is curled sleeping on one of the thick branches. The tree's upper branches hold a large net filled with dozens of glowing colorful orbs and spheres. A giant luminous pink full moon hangs in a starry twilight sky with orange and purple gradients. Surreal fantasy scene, detailed digital painting.
